historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2026 guidance (organic +3-4%, 2H +4-6%) cross-checked against the standalone pro forma revenue CAGR FY2023-25 of 1.4% (19,407 -> 19,945). Equity CAGR rejected as an anchor: it is negative because of $16B of buybacks over five years and the Solstice/Aerospace distributions, not because the business shrank.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: All numeric CAGRs above except standalone_revenue_2yr_cagr are computed on the PRE-SEPARATION consolidated company (Aerospace included; FY2020-FY2025 CSV rows) and describe an entity that no longer exists; they are reported for context only. Owner-FCF CAGRs use reported FCF - SBC - interest income (FY2020 5,027; FY2022 4,182; FY2025 4,857). Owner-FCF 3yr CAGR (5.1%) is below reported (6.4%) because interest income tripled with the pre-separation cash pile, not because SBC grew. Equity CAGR diverges >30% from revenue/EPS: buyback-driven, flagged and rejected.
historical_growth.notes: Standalone automation revenue was flat-to-low-growth FY2023-25 (+1.4% CAGR, with FY2024 down 0.6%) while Building Automation organic growth accelerated from 2% (2023) to 8% (2025) and PA&T/IA lagged. The base case's 4% organic is therefore ABOVE the standalone history and rests on guidance and BA momentum.

scenario_narratives.base: FY2026 guidance is delivered (revenue $19.8-20.0B all-in, segment margin 20.1-20.5%) and the standalone business then grows ~4% organically with Building Automation (+9% organic in Q2-26, 27% margin) carrying Industrial Automation (+4%) and a stabilising Process Automation & Technology (-1% in Q2-26). The JM Catalyst Technologies acquisition annualises in FY2027 and is margin-accretive; PSS/WWS leave in Q3-2026. Segment margin rises ~30bps/yr to ~23% by FY2030, well short of Rockwell but at Emerson's level. Terminal FCF multiple capped at 16x.
scenario_narratives.bull: The pure-play thesis is proven: BA compounds high-single-digit on data-centre, healthcare and fire demand; PA&T turns as refining, petrochemical and renewable-fuels catalyst cycles recover and JM cross-sell lands; Forge software attach shifts mix to recurring aftermarket. Segment margin approaches 25% and the business earns an 18x terminal FCF multiple; growth 8% in FY2027 fading to 3%.
scenario_narratives.bear: The company is what its standalone history says it was (FY2023-25 revenue CAGR 1.4%): PA&T keeps contracting as the aftermarket comp becomes a cycle, JM integration and stranded corporate costs (standalone Corporate & Other ran -$186M in Q2-26 vs -$57M allocated pre-spin) eat the guided margin expansion, and an industrial-capex downturn hits IA. Growth 1-2.5%, EBITDA margin settles ~21.8%, 14x terminal cap. Legacy liabilities (asbestos settlement, Flexjet litigation) and the Quantinuum mark are further downside not in the flows.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF component DCF on the STANDALONE automation business that exists after the June-2026 Aerospace spin, built from FY2026 guidance and the Q2-2026 standalone disclosures (revenue ~$19.9B all-in / ~$17.5B continuing after the PSS/WWS sales, segment margin ~20.3%, ~318M diluted post-reverse-split shares, ~$11.7B standalone net debt incl. JM). The historical CSV describes the pre-separation conglomerate and is used only as qualitative evidence of execution; do not 'correct' base_revenue back to the CSV's $37.4B FY2025 or $9.7B Q2-2026, and do not read the CSV's ~320M/~640M share rows as dilution. SBC expensed, count flat, interest in the WACC not the flows, risk charged once (flows and weights, WACC 8.5% unchanged across scenarios). Non-operating value bridged explicitly: 48% Quantinuum stake at a haircut to its quoted mark, PSS/WWS sale proceeds, NCI. The result is compared with a share price that embeds ~26x FY2026 adjusted EPS and ~18x continuing EV/EBITDA - a pure-play multiple the DCF only reproduces in the bull case.
key_risks_to_valuation: Base-year construction risk: FY2026 is a guidance year three months from completion and the standalone historical restatement (first in the Q3-2026 10-Q) may reset the revenue/margin base; the ~$2.4B PSS/WWS revenue and ~8% margin removed from base_revenue are estimates.

Quantinuum: $6.5B (~$20/share) of bridge value rests on a level-1 mark of a newly listed, loss-making quantum-computing company; the stake carries a 48% block, lock-up and tax leakage. Zero it and weighted IV falls ~$20/share.
Process Automation & Technology: -1% organic and -180bps margin in Q2-26; if the UOP aftermarket/catalyst cycle rolls over, the 4% base growth is too high.
Standalone cost structure: Corporate & Other of -$186M/qtr and JM integration dis-synergies could absorb the guided 250-290bps of margin expansion.
Legacy liabilities (asbestos settlement, Flexjet litigation) and the tax-free-spin compliance obligations are outside the flows.
Market multiple: the price implies a Rockwell-like multiple; the model's 16x FCF terminal cap (base) is the single most value-sensitive judgment.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API regular close at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 195.87-260.28.
data_sources.financials: SEC EDGAR: Q2-2026 10-Q (0000773840-26-000124, filed 23-Jul-2026: pre-spin consolidated balance sheet, debt note, Quantinuum Note 3/12, held-for-sale note, JM consideration); 8-K 23-Jul-2026 Ex. 99 Q2-2026 earnings release (standalone Honeywell Technologies table, segment results, FY2026 guidance, cash flow); 8-K 29-Jun-2026 Ex. 99.3 unaudited pro forma (standalone balance sheet 31-Mar-2026, standalone P&L FY2023-FY2025 and Q1-2026); SEC XBRL companyfacts for share counts and SBC; HON_Metrics.csv (pre-separation consolidated history, context only).

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026 CONTINUING revenue base, built from guidance not from the Metrics CSV. FY2026 guidance (Q2-26 release, 23-Jul-2026) is $19.8-20.0B for Honeywell Technologies all-in; that figure still carries the Productivity Solutions & Services and Warehouse & Workflow Solutions businesses (Industrial Automation; held for sale since 31-Dec-2025, sale agreements signed April 2026, both closing Q3 2026) at an estimated ~$2.4B/yr of low-margin revenue, and only ~5.5 months of Johnson Matthey Catalyst Technologies (closed 17-Jul-2026). Continuing base = 19,900 midpoint - ~2,400 PSS/WWS = ~17,500. The CSV's FY2025 revenue of $37,442M and Q2-2026 of $9,719M are the PRE-SEPARATION company including Aerospace (GAAP discontinued-ops restatement only begins with the Q3-2026 10-Q) and must not be used as a base year.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted, post 1-for-2 reverse split of 29-Jun-2026: 316.94M shares outstanding at 30-Jun-2026 (10-Q cover, dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding) plus 1.5M dilutive effect (Q2-26 diluted WA 318.6M vs basic 317.1M). Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would double-charge it. The CSV shares series (~320M and ~640M on adjacent rows) is a GAAP-lag artifact of the reverse split, not real movement.
inputs.net_debt_note: Standalone (ex-Aerospace) build from the 30-Jun-2026 consolidated balance sheet, which is still PRE-spin: consolidated debt 33,988 (CP 2,478 + current LTD 5,282 + LTD 26,228) less the $16.0B Aerospace Senior Notes carried at 15,851 (per the 31-Mar-2026 pro forma, 8-K 29-Jun-2026 Ex. 99.3) = 18,137; plus the $1,750M JM Catalyst Technologies consideration (10-Q, paid Q3-2026, assumed debt/cash funded) = 19,887 total debt. Cash 8,751 + short-term investments 445 less Aerospace cash ~989 = 8,207. Net debt 11,680. Cross-check: the 31-Mar-2026 pro forma standalone net debt was 9,498 (20,888 debt - 11,390 cash/STI); the difference is Q2 dividends (795), Quantinuum cash deconsolidated (623), net Q2 FCF, and the JM purchase. Operating lease liabilities (967 consolidated) are EXCLUDED: US GAAP operating lease cost is already inside segment profit/EBITDA (treatment B, charged once). PSS/WWS sale proceeds are in equity_bridge, not here.
inputs.sbc_source: Estimated standalone: consolidated SBC $196M FY2025 / $108M H1-2026 (cash flow statement add-back, no separate equity-award tax line disclosed), scaled by the standalone share of SG&A+R&D in the 31-Mar-2026 pro forma (5,732 / 7,262 = 79%) = ~$155M; rounded to $150M (~0.8% of continuing revenue). Reported FCF is the FY2026 guidance (~$2.0B, company definition: OCF less capex, adjusted for spin-related cost payments and Quantinuum). Interest income is the estimated standalone run-rate on ~$8-9B cash (consolidated $369M FY2025 on ~$12B). last_fcf = 2,000 - 150 - 250 = 1,600 is LEVERED owner FCF (after ~$775M gross interest expense); the component build below is UNLEVERED (interest sits in the WACC), so projected Y1 owner FCF is above last_fcf by roughly after-tax net interest (~$400M) plus the PSS/WWS-for-JM mix effect.
inputs.buyback_note: H1-2026 repurchases $1,000M (Q1 only; none in Q2 during the separation); FY2025 $3,804M pre-separation. The company is a repurchaser, so the flat share count is funded, not a modelling convention.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. Rf ~4.2% (10y UST, Sep-2026), beta ~1.05, ERP 5.0% -> cost of equity ~9.5%; pre-tax cost of debt ~4.8% (A-/A2-type issuer, Aerospace notes 3.9-5.85%) -> ~3.6% after tax; weights ~79% equity / 21% debt on $67B market cap and ~$18B gross debt -> ~8.2%, rounded to 8.5%. No standalone/execution premium is stacked on the WACC and the same rate is used in all three scenarios: that risk is charged ONCE, in the flows, via a 25% bear weight and a bear path in which PA&T keeps contracting and the JM integration disappoints (owner-fcf-adaptations section f).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B): operating lease cost is inside segment profit under US GAAP, so it is already charged in EBITDA; operating lease liabilities ($967M consolidated at 30-Jun-2026) are excluded from net debt. Finance leases are immaterial.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interest of $320M (30-Jun-2026, post Quantinuum deconsolidation) deducted once in equity_bridge; flows are modelled on the consolidated continuing business so no NCI leakage is charged in the tax rate.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (dcf-methods routing: operating company, US industrial, moderately cyclical -> owner-fcf.md plus the cyclical/lease/NCI/matching-asset adaptations). ENTITY DISCONTINUITY: Honeywell completed a three-way separation - Solstice Advanced Materials spun 30-Oct-2025, Honeywell Aerospace spun 29-Jun-2026 with a 1-for-2 reverse split, JM Catalyst Technologies acquired 17-Jul-2026. The remaining HON is a ~$20B automation company (Building Automation, Industrial Automation, Process Automation & Technology). Every row of HON_Metrics.csv through Q2-2026 is the OLD consolidated company (Aerospace still in continuing ops until the Q3-2026 10-Q), so the base year here is built from the Q2-2026 earnings release standalone table (Q2-26 revenue $5,187M, segment profit $985M = 19.0%, adj EPS $1.95) and FY2026 guidance (revenue $19.8-20.0B, organic +3-4%, segment margin 20.1-20.5% = +250-290 bps, adj EPS $8.05-8.35, OCF ~$2.1B, FCF ~$2.0B), and from the 8-K 29-Jun-2026 Ex. 99.3 pro forma (standalone revenue FY2023 19,407 / FY2024 19,281 / FY2025 19,945, and the 31-Mar-2026 standalone balance sheet). EBITDA DEFINITION: segment profit (which excludes SBC, acquisition amortization, pension income, repositioning, interest and Quantinuum) + depreciation (~1.65% of revenue) - a normalised recurring repositioning charge (~0.7%); acquisition-intangible amortization is treated as non-cash and its tax shield is ignored (conservative). FY2026 continuing-basis EBITDA margin 22.5% = ~22.0% continuing segment margin (all-in guide 20.3% midpoint less the ~8%-margin PSS/WWS businesses) + 1.65 depreciation - 0.7 repositioning - 0.5 haircut because Q2-26 actual was 19.0% and the guided H2 step-up is not yet delivered. EQUITY BRIDGE: (1) 48% Quantinuum stake, equity-method since the 4-Jun-2026 IPO; carrying $7,260M, quoted level-1 fair value $9,418M at 30-Jun-2026; its losses are excluded from segment profit (recast Q2-26) so the asset belongs in the bridge (matching-asset rule) - taken at $6,500M = quoted value less ~20% tax on the embedded gain and a ~15% block/lock-up/volatility discount; (2) PSS/WWS disposal group at fair value less costs to sell = net held-for-sale $1,091M (assets 2,366 - liabilities 1,275, after $311M H1 write-downs; gains above carrying are not recognised until closing, so proceeds are >= this); their revenue is removed from base_revenue so there is no double count; (3) NCI -$320M. NOT credited: the overfunded pension (non-cash ongoing income ~$170M/qtr consolidated, excluded from segment profit and from the bridge because the surplus is not distributable), strategically aligned equity investments ($1,167M; their equity income is inside segment profit so the asset stays out). Working capital: manufacturer with AR+inventory > AP (~15.5% of revenue on the pro forma), so growth consumes cash: wc_capture -15%. Buyback-funded flat count. FY2026 is a forecast base year three months from completion; the first standalone 10-Q (Q3-2026, due late Oct-2026) will restate history and is the trigger for the next update.

bear.narrative: Standalone reverts to the FY2023-25 pattern (1-2% growth): PA&T organic decline persists as the UOP aftermarket and catalyst cycle roll over, JM integration dis-synergies and stranded corporate costs (~$740M/yr standalone Corporate & Other) absorb the guided margin expansion, an industrial-capex downturn hits IA; margin slips back toward 21% EBITDA and the exit multiple compresses to 14x.

base.growth_note: FY2027 = ~4% organic + ~2.5pp JM Catalyst Technologies annualisation (~$800M/yr run-rate vs ~5.5 months in FY2026). Thereafter 4.5% fading to 3%: BA high-single-digit, IA mid-single-digit, PA&T low-single-digit with a catalyst/aftermarket cycle.
base.ebitda_margin_note: From FY2026 continuing 22.5% (pre-SBC, post normalised repositioning, incl. ~1.65% depreciation). +30bps/yr for four years from mix (BA at 27% growing fastest, JM catalysts accretive, PSS/WWS out) and the guided productivity programme, plateauing at 24.0% = ~23% segment margin - roughly Emerson's level, below Rockwell.
base.capex_note: Standalone PP&E is ~53% of consolidated ($2,494M of $4,664M pro forma); consolidated capex $986M FY2025 -> ~$460-520M standalone, ~2.6% of revenue, ~1.6x depreciation (JM catalyst plants and BA/IA software capitalisation).
base.cash_tax_note: Applied to EBIT after depreciation only (no shield from acquisition amortization). 21% federal + state + foreign mix; consolidated cash taxes ran ~33% of pre-tax in FY2025 (transaction-related), pro forma standalone FY2024 tax rate 31%.
base.narrative: Guidance delivered and sustained: 4% organic, margin +30bps/yr to ~23% segment margin, JM integrated on plan, PA&T stabilises after the FY2026 aftermarket comp. 16x terminal FCF cap: installed-base automation with recurring aftermarket, but still an industrial-capex-exposed business, not a 20x compounder.

bull.narrative: Pure-play re-rating thesis works operationally: BA compounds at 9-10% on data centres, healthcare and fire, PA&T recovers on refining/renewable-fuels catalyst cycles with JM cross-sell, Forge software attach lifts aftermarket mix; segment margin reaches ~25% (Rockwell-like) and the company earns an 18x terminal FCF multiple.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 16x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Moved from the 15/50/35 house default to 25/50/25. Bear up to 25%: three months of standalone trading history, an unproven standalone cost structure (Corporate & Other -$186M/qtr), a £1.325B acquisition closed three weeks after the spin, and a PA&T segment already in organic decline with margin contraction - the very risks the dcf-methods playbook says to charge in the flows rather than in an ad-hoc WACC premium. Bull cut to 25%: the bull case needs BA to sustain 9%+, PA&T to recover AND the JM integration to deliver simultaneously, while the shares already trade at ~26x FY2026 adjusted EPS, so much of the bull case is in the price.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
